text: Completed the unpublished matched runner without changing the foundation artifact DAG. The nested strict JVM build source-depends on image4s-nifti, image4s-reference, and reframe4s-motion. The candidate executes the canonical series estimator and native Lanczos-5 application; AFNI 26.1.04, nifreeze a3985fe5, and FSL 6.0.7.22 adapters retain raw transforms and normalize through independent full-affine landmark-tested conversions. Plan parsing enforces the frozen policy; the Node summarizer validates one record per plan row and emits deterministic JSON/CSV with visible failures and stage/RSS coverage. The repository-wide testAll court passes 442 tests across 82 JVM/Scala.js reports; optimized Node NIfTI passes 5/5.
